titel: Ice cream turns grainy or rock hard
kurz: Large ice crystals make ice cream grainy; too little sugar makes it hard.
bild_im_kopf: Like a gravel path instead of a sandy beach: it is the same stone, but you feel every grain underfoot.

ursachen.warum: Without stirring, a few large crystals grow.
fix: Stir vigorously every 30 minutes in the freezer, or use an ice cream maker

ursachen.warum: Sugar keeps part of it liquid. Without it, everything freezes solid.
fix: Do not cut the sugar much
A tablespoon of spirits or a little glucose syrup keeps it softer

ursachen.warum: When thawing, small crystals melt; when freezing again, the large ones keep growing.
fix: Do not leave ice cream out for long
Lay cling film directly on the surface

q1.frage: Is it more grainy or more rock hard?
